analyst_reports.business_description: Plant-forward frozen-food brand, family-founded, vertically integrated. Entry thesis (six quarters ago): category tailwind + brand conversion + margin expansion toward 20%+ + concentration reduction. Status: revenue milestones are landing (distribution expanded to tens of thousands of mass-retail doors; growth +37%), but every PROFITABILITY milestone has failed for four consecutive quarters and the original margin framework has been abandoned by management.
recent_developments: Gross margin has now printed ~10-11% for four straight quarters vs the 20-25% the thesis required; management blames freight/commodity inflation but competitors' margins have compressed far less.
Operating cash burn is severe (about -190 last FY, -98 last quarter alone); cash cover has fallen from 'years' to quarters.
The mass-retail expansion is REVENUE-successful but margin-dilutive: heavy slotting/promo spend, and the new doors reorder more slowly than club channels.

Plant-based category demand is now visibly slowing industry-wide; the category leader's growth has stalled to roughly flat — including its first-ever YoY quarterly revenue decline in the recent holiday quarter — and several peers have issued going-concern or restructuring announcements.

Management insists no equity raise is imminent and points to inventory/receivable normalization as the cash fix; sell-side is split between 'deep value on sales' and 'uninvestable until the burn stops'.
analyst_reports.macro_context: Aggressive central-bank tightening underway; speculative growth and listing-vehicle names down 70-90%; food inflation at multi-decade highs squeezing low-margin manufacturers hardest.
